Went in to sample the draft beers, but the pizza was great, too!
Apr 2026 • Couples
We stopped by one night after just randomly coming across this place while walking around. We’d been eating Thai and Vietnamese food for about three weeks and wanted something western.

We both got pizzas. Service was fast and friendly. Credit cards accepted.

I’m a beer lover. The craft beers are what really drew me in while we walking by.

I prefer Brown Ales and IPAs. Unfortunately, when I come to this part of the world, sometimes I am hard-pressed to find many these style of brews, so I have to drink the local and import lagers or pilsners. 

I tried a few pints of their different IPAs on tap. All of them were great and satisfied my desire for an IPA after multiple weeks of drinking lagers and pils. The pizza and fries were also great after no western food for three weeks.

Relaxed brasserie close to the markets!
Aug 2024 • Couples
My wife and I stayed in Saigon for 3 nights in August 2024 and we visited Pasteur Street craft beer and taproom in Ly Tu Trong twice! The beers are great and the staff are fun and friendly! If you don’t know your craft beer they will offer tastings and will help you narrow down your choice. But they do more than beer! They also have a great restaurant! They offer a range of western and Asian meals at a decent price and with generous servings! Thanks to everyone for making our stay so much fun!
